newsitem.title: USA: Purus says Mesznik resigns as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Purus says Mesznik resigns as CEO.

text.p: Purus Inc said Joel Mesznik has resigned as chairman, president and chief executive officer.
The company also announced that Russell Burbank was named as interim chief executive officer of the company.
Burbank formerly served as chairman, president and chief executive officer until his resignation in November 1996.
In April 1996, Purus sold substantially all of its assets, consisting primarily of air pollution control technology.
Burbank will oversee the wind-down of discontinued operations and handle Purus' administrative and reporting requirements.
He said the remaining company, a public shell with some cash, is actively seeking a new business and technology to acquire.
A new chief executive officer will be named after such an acquisition is made, he said.
